content.value: Fibonacci series is a series of numbers in which each number is the sum of the two preceding numbers. The simplest is the series 1,1,2,3,5,8 where the number of elements are 6. Now, draw a flowchart that can determine the fibonaccii series for any given number of elements.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2016
